product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Compact Free-Standing Floor Mount for Landscape or Portrait Displays Fits 23 to 55 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Compact Free-Standing Floor Mount for Landscape or Portrait Displays, Fits 23-55in TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Compact Free-Standing Floor Mount is a stationary, space-efficient solution for professional display installations. Designed to support 23" to 55" flat or curved TVs up to 77 lb (35 kg), it allows both landscape and portrait orientations, making it well suited for retail, corporate, and public-facing environments where a clean, permanent floor installation is required.Fixed, free-standing steel frame for stable floor-based display support without wall or ceiling attachmentSupports both landscape and portrait display orientationsSupports flat or curved TVs from 23" to 55" with a maximum load capacity of 77 lb (35 kg)VESA mounting patterns from 100×100 up to 400×400Clean footprint suited for lobbies, retail spaces, and conference roomsProfessional installation required; safety accessories must be used to prevent tippingIndoor, controlled-environment use onlyCompatible with VESA mounting interfaces as defined by the Video Electronics Standards Association COMPACT FREE-STANDING DESIGNThis mount provides stable floor-based display support without wall or ceiling attachment. The fixed, free-standing steel frame is designed for permanent placement in professional environments, offering a clean footprint for lobbies, retail spaces, and conference rooms. DUAL ORIENTATION SUPPORTThe mount supports both landscape and portrait display orientations. This flexibility allows installers to choose the orientation that best fits the content, whether horizontal presentations or vertical digital signage. DISPLAY SIZE AND WEIGHT COMPATIBILITYThe mount is designed for small- to mid-size commercial displays. It supports flat or curved TVs from 23" to 55" with a maximum load capacity of 77 lb (35 kg), providing reliable support for commonly deployed professional displays. VESA MOUNTING STANDARD SUPPORTThe mounting interface accommodates a wide range of display mounting patterns. It supports VESA® patterns from 100×100 up to 400×400, covering most displays within the supported size range. DESIGNED FOR INDOOR PROFESSIONAL USEThe mount is intended for controlled indoor environments.
